description: A sky prison fallen to earth. Fight through the Barracks, free the Valkyries in the Warded Cells, and climb the Sentencing Stair to the Trifang Warden. Level 40 by design (entry is capped by the current level cap).

actions.text: The Cohort Marshal falls. His strongbox is revealed.
The Brood Matron falls. Her clutch lies open.
The Hound falls. The prison is yours.

name: Fallen Prison
